room_rent.note: Room rent eligibility/limit not stated in policy wording; proportionate deduction clause applies if higher room chosen. Actual limit specified in Policy Schedule.

icu.note: ICU charges covered under in-patient hospitalisation; specific cap not stated in wording — refer Policy Schedule. ICU charges exempt from proportionate deduction.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment defined in wording; co-payment concept defined but no specific percentage applied. Policy Schedule may specify one.

sub_limits.display: Modern treatments capped at 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Modern treatments (robotic surgery, HIFU, etc.) capped at 50% of SI. Domiciliary hospitalisation capped at 10% of SI. Other sub-limits may be in Policy Schedule.

deductible.note: Deductible concept defined but no specific deductible amount stated in wording; refer Policy Schedule.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 24 or 48 months depending on plan chosen (Standard/Silver/Gold). Best achievable is 24 months.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 12-month waiting for cataract, hernia, BPH, hysterectomy, dialysis, gastric ulcers, hydrocele, fistula, sinusitis, tumours/cysts, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded under Excl 18. Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% renewal discount per claim-free year on cumulative basis, max 20%. All discount forfeited if claim made.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in policy wording.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation cover exists but number of days specified in Policy Schedule, not in wording.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation cover exists but number of days specified in Policy Schedule, not in wording.

day_care.note: Day care covered but limited to procedures listed in Annexure D, not all day-care procedures.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered up to 10% of SI; must last at least 3 continuous days; several conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, etc.).

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation covered under in-patient benefit up to Sum Insured.

organ_donor.note: Donor in-patient hospitalisation expenses covered for major organ transplant, subject to SI. Pre/post hospitalisation of donor not covered.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to limit specified in Policy Schedule (reasonable and customary charges).

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, stem cell, etc.) covered up to 50% of SI.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable expenses listed in Annexure A are excluded. Consumables during hospitalisation included in in-patient benefit but non-medical consumables excluded.

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India explicitly excluded. Policy covers treatment within India only.

moratorium.note: After 8 continuous years, no look-back except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30-day grace period for renewal; no coverage during grace period.

free_look.note: 15-day free-look period for new policies only; not applicable on renewals or portability.

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 45 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, overseas treatment, STDs, sleep apnea, external congenital anomaly, hearing aids/spectacles, dental (non-injury), circumcision, self-injury

optional_riders.display: Critical illness cover (Gold plan); Daily hospitalisation allowance; Nursing allowance; Recovery benefit; Accompanying person expenses
